evals.name: create the request pipeline from source
evals.prompt: Create a semantic board named `Flask request pipeline` at the service level describing how one HTTP request travels through Flask 3.0.0 as implemented in this checkout. The WSGI server calls Flask.wsgi_app (src/flask/app.py), which pushes the request context (src/flask/ctx.py) and calls full_dispatch_request. full_dispatch_request itself calls preprocess_request, then dispatch_request (which calls the matched view function), then finalize_request; finalize_request calls make_response and then process_response, and the response returns to the WSGI server. Draw the calls as the source makes them: the caller of each function is the function whose body calls it, so preprocess_request does not call dispatch_request and make_response does not call process_response. Give each part a configured kind and a one-line responsibility, put the app-internal parts inside a `Flask app` container, and bind each Flask-internal part to its source file; the WSGI server and the matched view function are outside this checkout and stay unbound. Read the board back and render it to pipeline.svg.

expectedFeatures.requirement: one board named exactly `Flask request pipeline` with level `service`
every node uses a configured kind; the WSGI server is `external`, dispatch steps are `function` or `module`
every node carries a one-line responsibility grounded in the source
app-internal parts are inside a single `Flask app` container; the WSGI server is outside it

each call lands on the internal function the source actually calls, from the function whose body calls it: full_dispatch_request calls preprocess_request, dispatch_request and finalize_request; finalize_request calls make_response and process_response; nothing lands on the container

every Flask-internal part is bound with the registered repository identity and a repo-relative src/flask path; the WSGI server and the matched view function, which are outside the checkout, carry no binding
pipeline.svg is written from the saved board
